chapters: Na pai' dhuuk cham tu'x jai'ch ka't, gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu tɨkɨr gio gu oidha'.
Gio gu oidha' cham tu'x bhaan ka't gio jix tukgam, gio gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix mii'ñdhix bhaan gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios: «Na jix tasi' ka'», gio ba' jix tasi' jum duu.
Gio gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' gu tasi' na jix bhai' ka't; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix gu tasi' gio gu tukgam.
Gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt Tanoolh gu tasi', gio gu tukgam jup tɨɨt Tukaa'; gio ba' xumai jum duu gio xibh jum duu, maa'n tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't gu tɨkɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' jix ai'chdhix gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr jix ai'chdhix gu suudai' mi'p bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr gu suudai' mi'p bhaan gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' ka't.
Gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt Tɨkɨr gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' xumai jum duu gio xibh jum duu, gook tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jum daa'ñ gu suudai' bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr pai' jix ñi'ñ jix gaki; mi' dhɨr ka't.
Gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt Oidha' gu jix gaki oidha', gio gu suudai' na jum daa'ñ jup tɨɨt Gɨ' Suudai'; gio gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' na jix bhai' ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu vaas jix maa gu kai'; mi' dhɨr gu u'u gu i'bhɨ jix maa gu i'bhɨ bhaan na jax chu'm gu kai' bhaan gu oidha'; jano' ba' ka't.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu vaas jix maa gu kai' bhaan na jax chu'm gu u'u jix maa gu i'bhɨ gu kai' bhaan na jax chu'm; gio ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu xumai gu xibh gu tanoolh vaik.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios: «Na jai'ch ka' gu tasi' tɨkɨr bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' jix ai'chdhix gu tanoolh gio gu tukaa', na ba' ka't pai' dhuuk gio gu tanoolh».
Gio na ka't gu tasi' tɨkɨr bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' jix tas duu bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' ja'p jum duu.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gook jix gɨ' tasi' tɨkɨr, gu jix gɨ' tas na jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu tanoolh, gio gu masad na jix ali' na jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu tukaa', gio gu si'avag.
Gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' jix tas duu bhaan gu oidha'.
Gio na jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu tanoolh gio bhaan gu tukaa', gio na jix ai'chdhix gu tasi' gio gu tukgam; gio gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' na jix bhai' ka't.
Gio ba' xumai jum duu gio xibh jum duu, maakobh tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix buusñi gu suudai' gu ko'oi gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig gu u'uvhig da'a bhaan gu oidha' jix kupi'ook gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu tai ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim gu suudai' bhaan na jax chu'm bɨx gu u'uvhig bhaan na jax chu'm; gio ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' aa' bham; gio ba' jix maa gu i'bhɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhuup gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu u'uvhig gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu xumai gu xibh gu tanoolh jixchamaam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig bhaan na jax chu'm gu vaakax gu ko'oi gu vaakax gu oidha' bhaan na jax chu'm; mi' dhɨr ka't.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu vaakax gu oidha' bhaan na jax chu'm gu vaakax bhaan na jax chu'm bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha' bhaan na jax chu'm; gio ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duu gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na jax chu'm jurtu'nka' na jax chu'm; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ'kora' gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax bɨx gu oidha' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ na jax chu'm gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ jix duu.

Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu i'bhɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhuup gu oidha' jix duñia' bhaan gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨx gu vaakax oidha' bhaan jiim bhaan pai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa bɨx gu vaas jix maa gu kai' bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu u'u cham tu'x jai'ch gu i'bhɨ gu u'u jix maa gu kai' ka't na ba' jugi.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax gu oidha' bɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨx oidha' bhaan jiim bhaan pai' cham tu'x jai'ch pai' bɨx gu vaas ka't na ba' jugi; gio ba' ka't.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix bhai'; gio ba' ka't gu xumai gu xibh gu tanoolh xijumai.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bɨɨx duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh kɨɨv gu ñi'ook jix utu'ñ gu tanoolh kɨɨv bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh kɨɨv jix bhaan duu na gu' jix utu'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaas yooxi' va'k jum duu gu oidha' bɨx gu vaas yooxi' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' cham ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' tu' ka't gu chio'ñ na ba' pai'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bɨx gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ oo' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu ux na tu ibai' u'uu pai' gu Edeen tas buusñi jix dhaas gu chio'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook maaxilhia' gu oidha' bɨx gu u'u gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñiata jix bhai' na ba' jugi; gio ba' gio gu u'u gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ u'uu pai' gu u'u xoi'kam cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' busaak gu Edeen gɨ' suudai' jiim na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uu pai' maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'n ka't gu Pisoon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mia'n bɨx gu oidha' gu abila pai' cham tu'x jai'ch jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix uam jodai mii' dhɨr gu oidha' jix bhai'; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gook gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Gioon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oidha' gu Etiopiia.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' vaik gɨ' suudai' jiim gu iddekel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' vupui bhaan gu Asiria; mi' dhɨr maakobh gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ jix dhaas u'uu pai' gu Edeen na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix nukadham.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ bham; gio ba' bɨx gu u'u u'uu pai' jugi.
Gu' gu' gu u'u gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam cham bhai' cham jugi; na gu' gu tanoolh koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix bhai' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ba'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' bɨx gu vaakax yooxi' bɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Adam na ba' gu ñi'ook ka't tɨɨt; gio ba' bɨx gu Adam jup tɨɨt gu vaakax na jix do'ig gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Adam gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx gu vaakax gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n yooxi'; gu' na ba' gu Adam cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Adam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu chuukug pai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Adam; gio ba' dhi' jano' o'o o'oo gu chuukug; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't mɨmɨim gu Barona na gu' gu chio'ñ ka't.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicha' gu chio'ñ gu taat gu naan tu' gu u'vɨ ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dha'npak gu Adam gu u'vɨ cham gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' gu ko'oi ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaakax yooxi' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham bɨx gu u'u u'uu pai'.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix aa' gu ko'oi; gio ba' gu i'bhɨ gu u'u u'uu pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu i'bhɨ gu u'u tɨjɨɨ'ñ u'uu pai' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham jugi tu' kuichdha' na gu' cham vaak jodai.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu ko'oi gu u'vɨ; gio ba' cham koi.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh ka't gu vupui boopoya' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios pu'ñir xoi'kam cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu u'vɨ gu u'u ka't jix bhai' na ba' jugi ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu u'u na ba' matda'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu i'bhɨ jix jugi; mi' dhɨr jix maa gio gu chio'ñ jix jugi na ja'p.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui ba'k jix maati' mi'p dha'npak; gio ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jajar iigɨx jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios u'uu pai' gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'u u'uu pai'.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ; gio ba' duukat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook u'uu pai' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ na gu' ka't tɨbiaptuda; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tɨbiaptuda gu u'u tu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ jix aa'; gio ba' gu u'vɨ chɨɨdak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix maa gu u'u tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix aa' gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu ko'oi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu ko'oi; na gu' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu vaakax tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu vaakax yooxi'; mi' dhɨr bhaan baaso oo' jugi bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kai'; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook mo'o tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ma'nkam; jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu u'u tu' bham cham jugi; mi' dhɨr ka't gu oidha' xoi'kam tu'; jano' ba' bɨɨx jugi bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jugi gu vaas yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha'; na gu' jix duñia'; na gu' oo' ka'.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu chio'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Eeba; na gu' ka't gu naan bɨx na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na ja'p maa'n pu'ñir xoi'kam cham bhai'; na gu' jano' na gu' cham gu novɨ gio gu u'u gu oidha' gu tai na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios u'uu pai' gu Edeen na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' gu chio'ñ jix dhaas tas buusñi u'uu pai' gu Edeen gu kuchii vaak na jix bhaan bɨx na ba' nukadham gu bhóogɨt gu u'u gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Konokioo gu Adam gu u'vɨ gu Eeba gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kaiin; gio ba' gu Adkuirido gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xibhɨk gu Abel; gio ba' ka't gu Abel bipia'dam kakneer gu Kaiin ka't gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Kaiin gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Abel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio maa'nkam mar kakneer; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Abel gu maa'nkar.
Gu' gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Kaiin gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Kaiin.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Kaiin; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka' tu' cham gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ ki'ñgob; gio ba' bɨɨx bɨx dhi' tu' ka't gu ñi'ook tu' gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Kaiin xibhɨk gu Abel; gio ba' ka't kua' yooxi' gu Kaiin jix búup bhaan xibhɨk gu Abel mu'aa.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Kaiin; gio ba' duukat gu Abel xibhɨk jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham tu'; jano' ba' jix duñia' tu' jix nukadham xibhɨk.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr xibhɨk duuñ tu' dɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu oidha' jix kupi'ook gu chin na ba' gu ɨ'ɨr xibhɨk gu novɨ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' cham tu' gu kavɨk; gio ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ka' gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Kaiin gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu oidha'; gio ba' jix duñia' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr no'x bakia' mu'aa.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tɨɨda' no'x kooda' gu Kaiin kɨɨv mui'kim ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas nɨi'ñchudat gu Kaiin na ba' cham no'x bakia'.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Kaiin vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix daa gu oidha' gu Nod tas buusñi gu Edeen.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kaiin gu u'vɨ gu enok; gio ba' pai'x kiicham jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham gu tɨɨgɨ' gu mar gu enok.
Jano' ba' gu enok gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Irad tu' gu Irad jix mar gu Meujael jix mar gu Metusael jix mar gu Lamek.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu Lamek gook gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Ada gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Silla.
Jano' ba' gu Ada gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jabal ka't gu taat vaak zel.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' xibhɨk ka't gu Jubal ka't gu taat bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Silla gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tubal-kaiin bɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Tubal-kaiin ka't gu Naama.
Ba' jix aa' gu Lamek gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu Ada gu Silla jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu Lamek gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; na gu chio'ñ kooda' gu ñi'ook biapma' koi'm.
Jano' ba' tu' kɨɨv mui'kim ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kaiin gu Lamek tu'r mui'kim kɨɨv ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix vɨɨk gu Adam gu u'vɨ gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Set; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' tu' gu kai' pai' gu Abel mu'aa gu Kaiin.
Jano' ba' gu Set gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Enoos; gio ba' jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ kua'da' mɨmɨim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' u'uan gu ma'nkam gu Adam; gio ba' gu tanoolh jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ na jax chu'm gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Adam gu tanoolh jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Adam chamaam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu mar na jax chu'm jurtu'nka' na jax chu'm jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Set.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tanoolh gu Adam mi' dhɨr jix mar gu Set gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix mar gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu tanoolh jix oidha' gu Adam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Set chamaam jixchamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu Enoos.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Set mi' dhɨr jix mar gu Enoos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv; gio ba' jix mar gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu tanoolh gu Set gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Enoos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu Kainaan.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Sem gu Japet jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook jix dhaas bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jiim bhaan gu ñi'ook gu taat ua'tulhdhidha' gu vupui cham gu ñi'ook gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Noee suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu mar.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Kanaan; mi' dhɨr tu duukam ka't gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sem gu Kanaan tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Japet jix duñia' vaak zel gu Sem gu Kanaan tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Noee mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook vaik mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu tanoolh gu Noee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx; gio ba' jix koi.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Noee; gio ba' gu Sem gu Kâm gu Japet gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Japet; gio ba' gu Gomer gu Magog gu Madai gu Jabaan gu Tubal gu Mesek gu Tiras.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gomer; gio ba' gu Askenas gu Ripat gu Togorma.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jabaan; gio ba' gu Elisa gu Tarsis gu Kittim gu Dodanim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suulhgia' jix bɨɨx duu chɨbɨɨp oi'ñga'n bhaan nɨɨn jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Nimrod gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Babel gu Erek gu Akkad gu Kalne gu oidha' gu Sinar.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' jix buus gu Assur gu Niinibe gu Reobot gu Kala.

Jano' ba' gu ebeo gu Arakeo gu Sineo.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Kâm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak ñiiñio'k oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sem; gio ba' gu Elam gu Assur gu Arpaxad gu Lud gu Aram.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aram; gio ba' gu Us gu ul gu Geter gu'.
Jano' ba' gu Arpaxad jix mar gu Sala jix mar gu eber.
Jano' ba' gu eber gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu ma'nkam; na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'n ka't gu Peleg na gu' gu tanoolh ka't gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' xibhɨk gu Joktaan.
Jano' ba' gu Joktaan jix mar gu Almodad gu Selep gu asarmabet gu Jera.
Jano' ba' gu adoram gu Usal gu Dikla.
Jano' ba' gu Obal gu Abimael gu Seba.
Jano' ba' gu Opir gu abila gu Jobad; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Joktaan.
Jano' ba' ka't ba'bhak dɨr gu Mesa bai'ñpu' gu Separ gu kavɨk baasɨ'n tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Sem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak ñiiñio'k oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Noee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' suulhgia' jix bɨɨx duu chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' nɨɨn gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook tas buusñi gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Sinar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tai; mi' dhɨr ka't gu ñi'ook pai' gu jodai gu ñi'ook pai'.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham bhi'ñbak gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham bhi'ñbak gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam maa'n bɨx suulhgia' namki'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' kua'da' cham tu' jano' jix duñia' bɨx.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñiiñio'k na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' tu ñi'ook duiñchu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dɨr bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kiicham.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Babel na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu oidha' dɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Sem; gio ba' gu Sem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix mar gu Arpaxad gook mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Sem mi' dhɨr jix mar gu Arpaxad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Arpaxad jix oidha' gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu Sala.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Arpaxad mi' dhɨr jix mar gu Sala gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik jix mar gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Sala gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu eber.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Sala mi' dhɨr jix mar gu eber gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik jix mar gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu eber gu ñi'ook maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu Peleg.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu eber mi' dhɨr jix mar gu Peleg gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix mar gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Peleg gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu Reu.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Peleg mi' dhɨr jix mar gu Reu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix mar gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Reu jix oidha' gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu Serug.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Reu mi' dhɨr jix mar gu Serug gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv jix mar gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Serug gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu Nakôr.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Serug mi' dhɨr jix mar gu Nakôr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Nakôr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu Tare.

Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Tare gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu Abraam gu Nakôr jix duu.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Tare; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar gu Abraam gu Nakôr jix duu; mi' dhɨr jix duu jix mar gu Lot.
Jano' ba' jix koi jix duu va'k gu taat gu Tare gu oidha' na jax chu'm gu Ur gu Kaldeos.

Gu' gu' gu Saara ka't gu ñi'ook cham ga'ra' gu mar.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Tare gu Abraam gu mar gu Lot gu mar jix duu gu mar gu Saara gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu Abraam gu mar; gio ba' jix buus bɨɨx gu Ur gu Kaldeos na ba' tu' gu oidha' gu Kanaan; mi' dhɨr tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm jix duu.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tanoolh gu Tare gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam; gio ba' jix koi gu Tare jix duu.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Abraam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu vaak gu taat gu oidha' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka' jix bhai' aa'.

Ba' jix aa' ka't gu Abraam na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't bɨɨx gu Lot; na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam na pai' dhuuk jix buus jix duu.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk tas buusñi gu Betel vaak zel ua'tulhdhidha' gu Betel tas gei'ñ gu ai tas buusñi; gio ba' pai'x jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n gu Faraoon gu vaak bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu Saara gu u'vɨ gu Abraam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Faraoon jup tɨɨt gu Abraam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Por gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ja'tkam bua' jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu' gu u'vɨ jano' gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' pai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook va'k; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lot jiim bɨɨx gu Abraam ga'ra' kakneer vaak zel.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' jix duu na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtda:―Aañ; na gu' ka't cham gu ñi'ook pai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu vaak na jix bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bipia'dam gu vaakax gu Abraam bipia'dam gu vaakax gu Lot; gio ba' gu Kananeo gu Pereseo oi'ñka' jano' ba' gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam gu Lot; na gu' cham ka't jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bipia'dam na gu' gu'ch gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' cham bɨx gu oidha' vupui bhaan tu' soi'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' tu' gu novɨ o'nsop tu' tu jiim gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook tu' tu jiim o'nsop.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lot gu vupui jix ñi' bɨx gu Jordaan bɨx ka't va'k gu Jawatan Dios gu Sodoma gu Gomorra na ja'p u'uu pai' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu oidha' gu Ejipto baakɨk gu Soar.

Jano' ba' gu oreos gu kavɨk gu Seir bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Paraan ju'ñdharan oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' suulh tɨɨtɨs gu Emmispat gu Kades gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Amalekitas gio gu Amorreo jix daa gu asesoon-tamar.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma gu gɨ'kora' gu Gomorra gu gɨ'kora' gu Adma gu gɨ'kora' gu Seboim gu gɨ'kora' gu Bela gu Soar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Siddim.

Jano' ba' maachim bhaan gu Kêdorlaomer gu gɨ'kora' gu Elam gu Tidal gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu Amrapel gu gɨ'kora' gu Sinar gu Ariok gu gɨ'kora' gu Elasar; gio ba' maakobh gu gɨ'kora' bhaan jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Siddim ka't jix bhuup gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jiboi'ññor gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma gu Gomorra ia'rɨ; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiboi'ññor gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sodoma gu Gomorra bɨx jix bɨɨx duu.
