Na pai' dhuuk jix buus gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma tu jiim na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kêdorlaomer gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx mi'p gu ñi'ook gu Sabe gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Melkîsedek gu gɨ'kora' gu Salem jix buusñi gu takarui' suudai' u'va; gio ba' ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x bia'ka' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x do'ñcho gu ñi'ook gu novɨ; gio ba' jix maa gu Abraam boosgi bɨx.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma gu Abraam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam gu gɨ'kora' gu Sodoma; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x bia'ka' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Na gu' dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook cham tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx na gu' cham; gio ba' tu' gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi'mɨk biipibop gu chio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu Aner gu Eskôl gu Mamre; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' cham jum i'obh gu Abraam; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daam jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu mar gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu vaak gu Damaskeno gu Elieser.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam; gio ba' cham jix maa bi'ya' maa'n maaxir gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't bham; gio ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ba'k ka't tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jix buusñi mai'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu tɨkɨr jix duñia' gu si'avag tu' no'p gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' ka't gu kai'.
Gu Abraam jix bhaan jum ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios, gio mi' dhɨr jix bhaan jum tɨɨ na jir bɨx bhai'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ur gu Kaldeos na ba' dhi' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ñ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaik gu ñi'ook vaik gu ñi'ook vaik gu ñi'ook gio.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx dhi' tu'x ta'tak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gu' cham ta'tak gu u'uvhig.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu u'uvhig bhaan gu chuukug koko'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas daam gu Abraam jix gɨ' bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam; gio ba' mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨda' gu kai' ka't gu oidha' cham tu juan ka't.
Gu' gu' gio gu ja'tkam tu juan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' bɨɨx jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' ɨlhdham tattat bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka' jix duñia' jix bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Amorreo bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu tas tu' gu ñi'ook kañdhiir gu tai gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax.

Jano' ba' jix duu mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Abraam bham; gio ba' gu kai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu oidha' dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim jix gɨ' gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' gu Kineos gu Kenekeos gu Kedmoneos.
Jano' ba' gu eteos gu Pereseos gu Rapaitas.
Jano' ba' gu Amorreos gu Kananeos gu Gergeseos gu Jebuseos.
Jano' ba' gu Saara gu u'vɨ gu Abraam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ga'ra' ja'tkam na tu juan gu Agar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Saara gu Abraam; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook koi'm; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' ja'tkam na tu juan; jano' ba' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu Abraam tu ñi'ook gu Saara.
Jano' ba' gu Saara gu u'vɨ gu Abraam jix bhɨɨ gu Agar ja'tkam na tu juan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx ka't gu Abraam gu oidha' gu Kanaan jix maa gu Abraam gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Agar; na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' ka't bɨɨx aapi'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Saara gu Abraam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' ja'tkam na tu juan baaso bɨɨx; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam gu Saara; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam na tu juan gu novɨ gu vupui bɨɨx xoi'kam tu'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Saara.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu suudai' oidha' jix gaki ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu bhóogɨt gu Sur.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Agar ja'tkam na tu juan gu Saara duukat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' duukat jix aa'; mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan gu Saara aapi'.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aapi' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gio nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam cham ka't jix duñia' kuiñcha.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu mar mɨmɨim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Ismael na gu' naak tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu novɨ bhaan bɨx gu noobh bɨx bhaan vupui bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ua'rgidhimɨk; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ñiata; na gu' jix aa'; jano' ba' cham buupui gio tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jup tɨɨt gu ñi'ook gu Poso na jix do'ig tu'; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kades gu Bered.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Agar gu Abraam gu mar jup tɨɨt gu Abraam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu mar gu Agar gu Ismael.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x na pai' dhuuk gu Agar gu Ismael.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu ñi'ook jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jiim vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix jai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bham.
Jano' ba' gu Yo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨndak; gio ba' ka' gu taat chɨbɨɨp.
Na gu' cham tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Abraam gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Abraam na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu taat chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' tu' chɨbɨɨp gu gɨ'kora' tu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan na ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' gu oidha' bɨx gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu maa'nkar; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jix vɨɨk gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu'; gio ba' ka't bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug gu ñi'ook ka't nɨi'ñchudat ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh ka't bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam; gio ba' maaxir gu vaak gu ñi'ook tuumiñ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham ua'tulhi'ñ gu kai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maaxir gu vaak gu ñi'ook tuumiñ; gio ba' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu chuukug na ba' ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook cham bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Saara gu u'vɨ cham mɨmɨim gu Saara gu' gu Saara ka't gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' aa' gio tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' ɨlhdham gu naan gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam ka't.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' maaxilhia' gu mar gu Saara tu' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Ismael gu tai vupui bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Saara gu u'vɨ tu' gu ñi'ook gu mar mɨmɨim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Isaak; mi' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan na ba' gu kai' mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ismael gio tu' naak; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' jix mui' jum duu jix mui' jix jai'; mi' dhɨr chiñia' jix mar jix duñia' gu ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' tu' dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Isaak tu' gu ñi'ook gu Saara gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook oi'ñga' buimgidhak.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu ñiokda' bɨɨx jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Abraam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Abraam gu Ismael gu mar bɨx tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak bɨx jiimɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuumiñ bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Abraam gu chuukug gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Ismael gu mar ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk ka't gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam tu' gu Ismael gu mar.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu vaak tu duukam maaxir gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuumiñ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Aparekioole gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mamre kua' daakat ki'ñgob vaak zel jix tónom gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui vaik gu chio'ñ mi'p ju'ñdharan; na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' jix buus jix duñia' ki'ñgob vaak zel tu jiim tu' bhaan gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan tu' jano' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook tu duukam.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu suudai' tɨɨt; gio ba' bɨtaa'n gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' mi' dhɨr; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' mia'n tu duukam; jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu vupui na ja'p tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel gu Saara; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jootom vaik jix duñia' gu vupui gu takarui' bɨtaa'n.
Jano' ba' dai'bus gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ tuur jix bhai'x jix bhai' jix maa.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bii'm tuur ka't jix dhaas vupui bhaan; gio ba' ka't ju'ñdharan bɨtaa'n gu u'u; mi' dhɨr koi'mɨk.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' duukat gu Saara gu u'vɨ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr vaak zel.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tɨɨda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu mar gu Saara gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Saara ki'ñgob vaak zel ka't.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam gu Saara jix duñia' kɨklhi'ñga'n ba'k gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu Saara ka't jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Saara tɨjɨɨ'ñ bham; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gio gu Jawatan tu' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu Saara bham; mi' dhɨr ka't tɨɨda' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Saara gu mar.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Saara gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ jix búup tu jiim bhaan gu Sodoma; gio ba' gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Abraam duñia'.
Jano' ba' dhaibu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' jix kavɨk dhaibu bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oidha'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu vaak mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios duñia' bɨx bhai' ñi'ook na jir bhai' na ba' jix ai gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Abraam tu' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu ñi'ook gu Sodoma gu Gomorra gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu' jix duñia' tu duukam bhaan tu ñi'ook tu' tɨbiap bɨɨx ka'm tu'; gio ba' tu' cham maachim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Sodoma; gu' gu Abraam ka't gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Abraam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio jir bhai' bɨɨx jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch mambhɨɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook kiicham; gio ba' gio cham uañi'ñka' pai' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' koi jir bhai' bɨɨx jix bhai'x ka't jir bhai' na ja'p jix bhai'x; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jir bɨx bhai' bɨx gu oidha' cham tu' gu ñi'ook jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' bakia' gu Sodoma mambhɨɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' pai' xoi'kam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jano' kua'da' ñiokda' gu Jawatan jix duñia' oo' maatai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx jir bhai' ja'tkam jixchamaam; gio ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jixchamaam bɨx kiicham jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham tu' bakia' oo'm jixchamaam.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñiokda'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook oo'm; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' cham xoi'kam oo'm.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu Jawatan tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham tu' bakia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ñiokda' gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham jix aa' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga; gio ba' cham jano' gu Jawatan tu' tu ñi'ook jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx; jano' ba' cham jix aa' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix bɨɨx duu ñiokda' gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook daada' gu Sodoma gu xumai; gio ba' gu Lot ka't daakat ki'ñgob gu Sodoma; mi' dhɨr gu Lot jix búup tu jiim tu' bhaan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jano' gu Jawatan soi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak tu duukam tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu xibh gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham ɨrban dhi' gu tukaa'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix jai' tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx baap gu vaak; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu takarui' cham jabka' koi'mɨk.
Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu chichio'ñ kiicham gu chio'ñ gu Sodoma bɨx gu ja'tkam ju'ñdharan dɨr bɨɨx ka'm jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu Lot gui'p; gio ba' duukat gu chio'ñ tɨɨtɨs tu' dhi' gu tukaa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Lot jix buus ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob bhaan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' soi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu' no'ñ gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ cham jix duñia' gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jix buusñi na ja'p xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam gu chio'ñ cham cham tu' tɨɨtɨs ɨkgiga'n.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' suudai' u'va na ba' na ja'p gu tanoolh na jix bhai' tu jiim jir bɨx bhai' jano' tu' chulhiiñchuda' cham bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Lot gu ñi'ook na ba' kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Lot gu vaak bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ mi'p ki'ñgob gu vaak dɨr jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx; gu' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu chio'ñ gu Lot; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñdha' gu Yernos gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨx kiicham dhi' pai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' duu dhi' pai' na gu' tu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' na ba' cham tu' duu.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix buus gu Lot gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga jix bhɨɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' jix búup dhi' pai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham tu' duu dhi' kiicham; gu' na ja'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' daada' gu Lot bham; na gu' bamii' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bakia' na gu' cham sɨlhka'n kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu novɨ gu u'vɨ gu noobh gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx; gio ba' jix dhaas mai' kiicham.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na pai' dhuuk ka't jix buusñi mai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr cham bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk cham ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu Lot; gio ba' cham tu' soi'ñ gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu' gaagam tu duukam nɨidhidha' gu vupui xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gu' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk cham ka't cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' dhi' kiicham mia'n na ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jano' cham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n ii'mdagaram gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dho'ñchidhak gio ñi'ook Jawatan bhaan dhi' cham kiicham tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' cham tu' duñia' bɨɨx ka'm cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham gu Soar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tas busaak bhaan gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk gu Lot gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Soar.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Sodoma bhaan gu Gomorra choiñ gu tai baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh bɨx mii' dhɨr bɨɨx bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr jɨ'dɨlh gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu Lot gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh pai' ka't dhi' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu jiim bhaan gu Sodoma gu Gomorra bhaan bɨx gu oidha' mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim; gio ba' kuubh gu oidha' na ja'p kuubh.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jɨ'dɨlh tɨ'ñcho gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam bhañ mai' gu Lot tɨjɨɨ'ñ chajaañ jɨ'dɨlh pai' gu Lot ka't.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Lot jix tɨ'ɨ gu Soar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨɨx; na gu' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ gu Soar jumpa'n gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix gɨ' jix ali'; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu taat jix duñia' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'i suudai' u'va chulhiiñdha' gu taat bɨɨx chulhiiñdha' gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix maa i'i suudai' u'va gu taat mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' chɨbiapui jix gɨ' jix koox bɨɨx gu taat; gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duuk jix duñia' tu' duuk jix búup.

Ba' jix aa' gu tanoolh buimgidhak jix gɨ' jix ali'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tukaa' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu taat; mi' dhɨr i'i suudai' u'va gio dhi' gu tukaa' ba'k bɨɨx na ba' chulhiiñdha' gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix maa i'i suudai' u'va gu taat gio mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' jix búup jix ali' jix koox bɨɨx; gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duuk jix duñia' tu' duuk jix búup.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Lot gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Moab gu taat gu Moabitas bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix ali' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Ben-ammii gu taat gu Ammonitas bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Abraam gu oidha' gu Mediodiia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kades gu Sur jix daa na ja'p ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu Gerar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam gu Saara gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Abimelek gu gɨ'kora' gu Gerar bhañ jix bhɨɨ gu Saara.
Ba' jix aa' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va gu Abimelek tɨɨtki' gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi kuiñcha gu u'vɨ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Abimelek cham ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan koo'nda' gio gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' cham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gio jix aa'; jano' ba' xibhɨk bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu noobh gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨtki'; gio ba' tu' gio tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook dhi'; mi' dhɨr tu' gio tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan tu' cham tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu chio'ñ; na gu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' ii'mdagaram; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tɨɨda' koi bɨɨx bɨx ua'tulhi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abimelek jix búup gu xibh jup tɨɨt bɨx tu duukam bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook maatɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt gu Abimelek gu Abraam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan tu' jix duñia' bhaan tu' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ cham gu Abraam gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abimelek gu Abraam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na ba' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix aa'; na gu' tu ñi'ook na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr tɨɨda' cham cham tu'x jai'ch choo'n gu Jawatan Dios dhi' pai' yaa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' tu'r gio gu ja'tkam mar u'vɨ gu taat gu' cham mar u'vɨ gu naan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duu ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu taat tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' tu' jix duu bɨx pai' tu'; mi' dhɨr xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abimelek jix bhɨɨ kakneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam jix maa gu Abraam gu Saara gu u'vɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abimelek; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' vupui bhaan tu' jix daa pai' xoi'kam tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Saara; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa jix bhai'x jix toja jodai xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu vupui na ba' bɨx bɨndak na ba' bɨɨx bɨx; jano' ba' ka't.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Abimelek gu u'vɨ gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' ka't bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Abimelek kuiñcha gu Saara gu u'vɨ gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Bisitoo gu Jawatan Dios gu Saara na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Saara na ja'p ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Saara gu Abraam gu mar gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Abraam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Saara gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu mar gu Isaak gu tanoolh na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Abraam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu Isaak gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Saara; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'x jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' chɨkka tu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu Saara ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu Abraam gu tanoolh ka't gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Saara gu mar gu Agar gu Egipkia ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim dhi' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu mar; na gu mar dhi' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios cham tu' bɨɨx gu mar bɨɨx gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Abraam kuiñcha gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a kuiñcha gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios; na gu' bɨx tu' tu ñi'ook gu Saara gu ñi'ook na gu' gu Isaak tu' ka't mɨmɨim gu ma'nkam.
Na gu' gio gu mar gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam na gu' gu kai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abraam jix búup gu bhóogɨt gu xibh jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' jix maa gu Agar bhaan gu ñi'ook do'ñcho gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ta'tak jiim oidha' jix gaki gu Beer-seba.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu u'u.
Jano' ba' ka't jix daa gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu Tiro gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ; na gu' chɨtda; na pai' dhuuk cham na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix daa gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt gu Agar dɨr gu tɨkɨr jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Agar cham jum i'obh; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' naak gu ñi'ook pai'.
Na gu' bamii' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu novɨ na gu' gu ja'tkam no'ñ jix dhaas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix kupi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui jix ñi' suudai' buusñi gu suudai'; gio ba' ka't jix bhuup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' jix maa i'i gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix daa oidha' jix gaki ka't u'u gat.
Jano' ba' jix daa oidha' jix gaki gu Paraan; gio ba' gu naan jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Abimelek gu Pikol gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Abraam bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan.

Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ta'm na tu maakia' gu Dios tu' gu mar tu' gu ja'tkam; gu' gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' joi'gɨ'nda' tu' bɨndak jix duu tu' bɨɨx gu oidha' pai'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam; gio ba' tu' ñi'ook kavɨk aa'.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abimelek kuiñcha gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu duukam gu Abimelek gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abimelek; gio ba' cham tu' chɨkka ka't gu ñi'ook dhi' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' maachim tu' naak bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Abraam kakneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa gu Abimelek; gio ba' tu' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Abraam kɨɨv ali' karneer kakneer dɨlhkob.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abimelek gu Abraam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' kɨɨv ali' karneer gu ñi'ook dɨlhkob.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; na dhi' kɨɨv ali' karneer gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu novɨ na ba' ka't chuut tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr pai' gu Beer-seba; na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Beer-seba; gio ba' jix búup gu Abimelek gu Pikol gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham suulh gu oidha' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Beer-seba tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu oidha' gu Pilisteos mui'x gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x vaak zel gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Abraam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ jano' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Isaak gu oidha' gu Moria maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan maa'n gu kakkavɨk tu'.

Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix búup gu bhóogɨt gu xibh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ baidhak gook gu Isaak gu mar; gio ba' gu u'u na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan jix búup ka't pai' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'.
Jano' ba' vaik gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu vupui jix ñi' pai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Abraam gu u'u maa'nkar tai bhaan jix dhaas bhaan gu Isaak gu mar; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu tɨtda:―Aañ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaak gu Abraam gu taat; gio ba' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu mar; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Miren gu tai gu u'u; gu' duukat mar kaneer na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar kaneer na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu mar; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tɨtda:―Aañ.
Jano' ba' jix duu na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Abraam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu u'u gu Isaak gu mar jix dhaas jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jiiñak gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu Abraam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' cham tu'; na tu' kakasnira' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu mar.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu vupui gu ñi'ook a'aa'; gio ba' ka't gu Abraam jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan pai' gu mar.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Abraam gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na ba' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios ka't.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gookim jix duñia' dɨr gu tɨkɨr.
Ba' jix aa'; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu ñi'ook dhi' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix bhai' aa' jix mui' gu kai' na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' gu kai' gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob obhɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' gu kai' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam jix búup jix bɨɨx duu tɨtda:―Aañ gu Beer-seba; gio ba' jix daa gu Abraam gu Beer-seba.
Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam bham; gio ba' gu Miren gio gu Milka tu' gu ma'nkam gu Nakôr xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu us maa'nkam mar gu Bus xibhɨk gu Kemuel gu taat gu Aram.
Jano' ba' gu Kêsed gu aso gu Pildas gu Jidlap gu Betuel.
Jano' ba' gu Betuel jix mar gu Rebeeka; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Milka gu Nakôr xibhɨk gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Reuuma gio gu Teba gu Gaam gu Taas gu Maakâ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oidha' gu Saara chamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu oidha' gu Saara.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Saara gu Kiriat-arba gu ebroon gu oidha' gu Kanaan; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Saara jix xuaak.
Ba' jix aa' jix búup gu Abraam vupui bhaan jix koi gu ma'nkam gu et bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix koi vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu et gu Abraam gui'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch; gio ba' tutkɨ air gu ñi'ook jix koi; mi' dhɨr no'ch tu' na ba' jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix búup tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu et.
Ba' jix aa' bɨɨx bham; gio ba' tu' namki' aagak tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi vupui bhaan tu' bɨɨx gu Eproon gu mar gu Soar.
Na ba' na ba' jix maa jumpa'n gu Makpela juraa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar; na jir bhai' u'uuk jix maa na ba' gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Eproon gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu et; gio ba' jix aa' gu Eproon gu eteo gu Abraam maatɨt gu ma'nkam gu et bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob kiicham bham.
Jano' ba' cham gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu maa'nkar tu' gio jumpa'n; mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam tu'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Eproon maatɨt gu ja'tkam gu oidha' bham; gio ba' va'k tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr tu' u'uuk gu maa'nkar tu' jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Eproon gu Abraam tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu oidha' jix duñia' jix toja jodai; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jix koi.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Eproon gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu Eproon tuumiñ gu ma'nkam gu et jix toja jodai jix bhai' ñi'ook na tu a'ga tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu Eproon ka't gu Makpela gu ñi'ook gu Mamre gu maa'nkar jumpa'n ka't bɨx gu u'u ka't gu maa'nkar bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu maa'nkar ñiata gu ma'nkam gu et bɨx ki'ñgob kiicham.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu Saara gu u'vɨ jumpa'n gu maa'nkar gu Makpela gu ñi'ook gu Mamre gu ebroon gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar jumpa'n ka't gu Abraam gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu et.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam ka't jix duñia' xoi'kam kia'mi'ñ gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam bɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu vaak ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx ga'ra'; gio ba' jix dhaas jano' gu novɨ bɨtaa'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' cham jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Kananeos tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ cham tu' dhi' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu mar gu oidha' pai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abraam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr jix bhɨɨ gu vaak gu taat gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu kai' dhi' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook nobii'ñ vupui bhaan tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar.
Jano' ba' tu' gu u'vɨ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ka' namkidhat dhi' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu mar.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' jix dhaas gu novɨ bɨtaa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook bhaan dhi'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ mambhɨɨx jix ai gu Jawatan ka't ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jix bhai' gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Mesopotamia kiicham gu Nakôr.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ai mai' kiicham ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu tas gu xumai gu tas gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' soi'ñ mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu vupui xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu suudai' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu chio'ñ dhi' kiicham gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' i'i gio i'i jix ai; na ka't tu' na ba' tu duukam gu Isaak; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' ka't va'k gu ñi'ook ñiokda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rebeeka ka't maaxir gu Betuel gu mar gu Milka gu u'vɨ gu Nakôr xibhɨk gu Abraam busaak bɨɨx bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ cham ka't; gio ba' jix dhaav suudai' buusñi jix bhuup.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix duñia' dai'bus bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'i gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' i'i gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix maa bhaan gu novɨ jix maa i'i.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu jix duu i'i; gio ba' gio na ba' jix ai jix buusñi gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook i'i.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dai'bus jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' jix buusñi na ba' bɨx jix ai.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' maachim tu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix ai jix bɨɨx duu i'i gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix uam jodai tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook mambhɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ gu Rueegote cham tu'x jai'ch pai' gu vaak gu taat pai'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' mar u'vɨ gu Betuel gu mar gu Milka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nakôr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gio cham tu'x jai'ch gu vaak jix jai' jix duu pai' na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam cham jix ai'chdhix xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dai'bus tu' maachim gu vaak gu naan dhi' tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu Rebeeka ga'ra' xibhɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Labaan dai'bus gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ suudai' buusñi.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na ja'p jix ñi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh gu ja'tkam chɨtda mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; gio ba' suudai' u'va; mi' dhɨr ka't ju'ñdharan jix ai suudai' buusñi.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix ai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook mai' tu' gu vaak pai' na ba' jix ai.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ suudai' u'va gu vaak gu Labaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ai; gio ba' jix maa jix duu gu suudai' na ba' jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx aajidha'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi; gu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham jugi bɨɨx ka'm ka't tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' tu'; gio ba' tu' jix maa kakneer jix toja jodai jix uam jodai tu duukam jix ai gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Saara gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Jawatan tu' jix maa bɨx juraa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk aa' bham; gio ba' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Kananeos gu oidha'.
Gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu taat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ cham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook nobii'ñ bɨndak gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ na ba' gu mar gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu taat.
Na pai' dhuuk jano' ba' ka' namkidhat gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam; gio ba' tu' cham tu' ka' namkidhat gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook suudai' buusñi tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu Abraam tu' jano' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu suudai'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr i'i tu' soi'ñ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Bebe tu' gio na ba' jix ai jix buusñi gu suudai'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu u'vɨ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu mar gu Jawatan.

Jano' ba' va'k gu ñi'ook ñiokda' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rebeeka busaak bɨɨx bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix dhaav suudai' buusñi jix buusñi gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix duñia' i'i.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim; gio ba' i'i gio jix ai i'i; mi' dhɨr jix maa gio i'i jix ai.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr mar u'vɨ gu Betuel gu mar gu Nakôr gu Milka; jano' ba' bhaan daak bhaan gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu Abraam ka't gu bhóogɨt tu'r na ba' jix bhɨɨ mar u'vɨ xibhɨk gu Jawatan na ba' gu mar.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' jix bhai'x xoi'kam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' cham; mi' dhɨr kɨɨ'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Labaan gu Betuel tu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook dhi'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook cham bhai' tu' jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rebeeka vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' ka't gu u'vɨ gu mar gu Jawatan na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix duñia' gu Abraam jix kai gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jajannulhi'ñ jix maa gu Rebeeka; gio ba' gio jix maa tu'x a'bhar xibhɨk gu naan.
Jano' ba' koi'mɨk i'i gu chio'ñ aajidha' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' kɨkbo gu xibh jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa' xibhɨk gu naan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx no'ch mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr na ba' gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' ba'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu Rebeeka gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx dhi' gu chio'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Rebeeka gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Abraam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Rebeeka gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' jix búup jano' ba' gu Rebeeka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jix ai bhiadat gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu Rebeeka ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Isaak oidha' suudai' na jix do'ig tu'; na gu' jix daa gu oidha' gu Mediodiia.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Isaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu tas gu xumai; gio ba' gu vupui jix ai aajidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Rebeeka gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui jix ñi' gu Isaak jix dhaav jix ai.

Na gu' na gu' ka't tu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' chɨkka dhi' gu chio'ñ jupaabkamu'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' bhaan no'ch tu duukam ka't tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Jawatan; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' jix bhaan dhaas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Isaak bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Isaak vaak zel gu naan gu Saara jix bhɨɨ gu Rebeeka gu u'vɨ; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Isaak mi' dhɨr koi'm gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Ketura.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Simram gu Joksan gu Medan gu Midiam gu Isbak gu Sua.
Jano' ba' gu Joksan jix mar gu Seba gu Dedaan; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Dedaan jix bɨɨx duu gu Assurim gu Letusim gu Leummim.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Midiam; gio ba' gu Epa gu Eper gu Enek gu Abida gu Eldaa; mi' dhɨr bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Ketura.
Jano' ba' gu Abraam jix maa bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra' gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ jix maa gu Abraam juana' bhañ ju'ñdharan gu Isaak gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tas buusñi gu oidha' gu ux na tu ibai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tanoolh gu oidha' jix oidha' gu Abraam; gio ba' chamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix koi gu Abraam jix bhai' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x jix bhuup gu tanoolh ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Isaak tu' gu Ismael gu ma'nkam jumpa'n gu Makpela gu maa'nkar gu Eproon gu mar gu Soar gu eteo gu ñi'ook gu Mamre.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu ma'nkam gu et; gio ba' ka't gu Abraam jix duñia' gu Saara gu u'vɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr jix koi gu Abraam gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' aa' gu Isaak gu mar; gio ba' jix daa gu Isaak ju'ñdharan oidha' suudai' na jix do'ig tu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Ismael gu mar gu Abraam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Agar gu Egipkia ja'tkam na tu juan gu Saara.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Ismael gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' maa'nkam mar gu Ismael gu Nabaiot; mi' dhɨr gu Kedar gu Abdeel gu Mibsam.
Jano' ba' gu Duma gu Massa.
Jano' ba' gu adad gu Tema gu Jetur gu Napis gu Kedema.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Ismael dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' chiñia'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ismael chamaam gu ñi'ook kɨɨv; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Ismael jix koi; mi' dhɨr ka't gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu abila bɨɨx ka'm gu Sur gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto bai'ñpu' gu Asiria; gio ba' jix koi bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Isaak gu mar gu Abraam; gio ba' gu Abraam jix mar gu Isaak.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Isaak oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu Rebeeka mar u'vɨ gu Betuel gu Arameo gu Padan-aram gu ja'tkam gu Labaan gu Arameo.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Isaak gu Jawatan Dios gu u'vɨ ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Rebeeka gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gook chɨbɨɨp cham tu'x jai'ch baaso gook gu ja'tkam ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr ba'k; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam ka't jix kavɨk gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' tu juan jix ali'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na ba' gu ñi'ook vook.
Jano' ba' jix buus maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx na ja'p; gio ba' tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Esauu.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix buus xibhɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Esauu; gio ba' ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jakob; na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Isaak gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook a'aalh gu Esauu ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ yooxi'; gio ba' gu Jakob cham gu ñi'ook ka't gu chio'ñ jix daa vaak zel.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Isaak gu Esauu na gu' gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Rebeeka dha'da' gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob; gio ba' gu Esauu yooxi' jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi gu ñi'ook dhi' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x; na ba' gu ñi'ook ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Edom.
Jano' ba' gu Jakob jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Esauu; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' koi; mi' dhɨr na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jakob jix maa gu Esauu gu takarui' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix jugi jix i'i jix búup ka't; mi' dhɨr gu Esauu.
Jano' ba' ka't bhiogi' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhiogi' ka't gu tanoolh gu Abraam; gio ba' ka't gu Isaak gu Abimelek gu gɨ'kora' gu Pilisteos gu Gerar.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu abita dhi' gu oidha' jix duñia' bɨndak tu' jix bhai' aa'; na gu' tu' gu kai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr gu kai' bɨx dhi' oi'ñga'n; gio ba' bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' ka't gu kai'.
Na gu' na gu' jix kai gu Abraam gu ñi'ook nukadham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Isaak gu Gerar.

Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ mii' dhɨr pai' tɨkka gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam; na gu' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ a'ga; gio ba' gu u'vɨ; na jix duñia' jix aa' gu chichio'ñ pai' kooda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu Rebeeka; na gu' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr juruuñ mui'x gu tanoolh gu Abimelek gu gɨ'kora' gu Pilisteos tɨɨgɨk gu ñi'ook jix ñi' gu Isaak bɨɨx gu Rebeeka gu u'vɨ.

Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Abimelek gu Isaak; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨda' gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Isaak jix aa'; na gu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr koi kuiñcha.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abimelek; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' gu Por gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu u'vɨ bhaan no'ch uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abimelek jix aa'ñdhix bɨx gu ja'tkam bham; na kuichdha' dhi' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ tɨɨda' koi.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Isaak mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr oi'ñga' chamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer jix gɨ'; gio ba' gu Pilisteos chooto'n jɨɨgak.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kupi'ook gu Abraam gu taat gu tanoolh gu Pilisteos gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abimelek gu Isaak; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch na gu' jix jai' gu ñi'ook no'ch tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Isaak ka't; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel gu Gerar jix daa.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhi'spio'kai gu Isaak gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix kupi'ook gu tanoolh gu Abraam gu taat gu Pilisteos jix koi gu Abraam; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu taat ka't tɨɨgim.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu Isaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bipia'dam gu Gerar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bipia'dam gu Isaak bham; gio ba' gu suudai'; na gu' gu ñi'ook jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Esek na gu' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gio bhaan; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Sitna.
Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix jix kupi'ook gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Reobot jix aa'; na gu' jano' tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Beer-seba.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu taat; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh tu' jix duñia' bɨndak tu' jix bhai' aa' gu kai' xoi'kam gu Abraam tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios vaak zel; gio ba' tu duukam gu Isaak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Abimelek suudai' u'va dɨr gu Gerar gu Aussat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pikol ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Isaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buupui gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' ka't jano' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch tu' chulhiiñchuda' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨndak.
Na cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' na ja'p no'ch cham tu' dhaa na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' jano' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi'mɨk i'i.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook maa'n; gio ba' tu' gu Isaak bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨtɨs gu Isaak jix maa gu ñi'ook jix kupi'ook gui'p; gio ba' gu suudai' gaagam.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Seba; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr kiicham gu Beer-seba bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Esauu ka't oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu Judit mar u'vɨ gu Beeri gu eteo gu Basemat mar u'vɨ gu Eloon gu eteo.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Isaak gu Rebeeka.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Isaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui cham ñiata jup tɨɨt gu Esauu gu mar jix gɨ'; gio ba' gu mar; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' cham tu' gu tanoolh koi'm.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jano' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix buus yooxi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p tu' jugi; na ba' tu' gu i'ii'ñ va'k.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Rebeeka ka't tɨiñ na pai' dhuuk ua'rgidhimɨk gu Isaak gu Esauu gu mar; gio ba' ka't gu Esauu yooxi' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Rebeeka gu Jakob gu mar bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' naak gu taat ua'rgidhimɨk bɨɨx gu Esauu xibhɨk bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na ba' tu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios va'k tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' jano' gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook jix bhai' chiiw gu ñi'ook koi' na ba' gu taat na ja'p.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat jugi na ba' tu' va'k koi'm.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu Rebeeka gu naan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esauu xibhɨk gu chio'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel gu taat bhaan tu' mu'ai cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu naan jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' mu'ai; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu naan; gio ba' gu naan jix duu na ja'p gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Rebeeka jajannulhi'ñ gu Esauu gu mar jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra' gu vaak gu Jakob gu mar jix ali'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook bhaan gu noobh bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' cham ga'ra' tɨɨt chiiw gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' do'ñcho gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' ka't gu novɨ gu Jakob gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' ka't gu taat; gio ba' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' chɨkka gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu taat; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Esauu maa'nkam mar; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ja'p tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' bamii' jano' xanoop jugi gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaak gu mar; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bakia' gu ñi'ook jootom gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu vupui bhaan tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Isaak gu Jakob; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu' gu mar gu ñi'ook tu' gu mar gu Esauu cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob gu taat gu Isaak; gio ba' jix duñia' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jakob gu' gu noobh gu Esauu.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu noobh jix duñia' na ja'p gu noobh gu Esauu; gio ba' jix bhai' aa'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu mar gu Esauu jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi gu ñi'ook gu mar na ba' tu' gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix jugi; jano' ba' gio suudai' u'va jix i'i.
Ba' jix aa' gu Isaak gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Isaak gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ jix bhai' aa' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu mar na ja'p gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tiriik.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu ja'tkam tu' gu ma'nkam gu naan; mi' dhɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Isaak gu ñi'ook jix bhai' aa' gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jakob vupui bhaan gu Isaak gu taat gu Esauu xibhɨk suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat; gio ba' gu taat gu ñi'ook gu mar na ba' gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaak gu taat; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu mar maa'nkam mar gu Esauu.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Isaak bɨɨx jix gɨ' jix duñia'; gio ba' chɨkka suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook bɨx va'k tu' ka't.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Esauu jix kai gu ñi'ook gu taat tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gio tu' gu taat.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' suudai' u'va xibhɨk bɨɨx iatda' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' xoi'kam tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jakob tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook mui'kim; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx jano' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook na ba' tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Isaak gu Esauu; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan jix maa tu duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tiriik suudai' u'va; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jano' gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Esauu jix aa' gu taat; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu taat gio tu' gu taat; mi' dhɨr gu Esauu gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaak gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ba'bhak gu oidha' gu tɨkɨr jiix.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii ii'mdagaram xibhɨk; na pai' dhuuk tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esauu gu Jakob gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka't gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu taat tu' kooda' gu Jakob xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu tu ñi'ook gu Rebeeka gu ñi'ook gu Esauu gu mar jix gɨ'; gio ba' bhañ jup tɨɨt gu Jakob gu mar jix ali' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esauu xibhɨk gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx kooda'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bamii' gu Labaan xibhɨk jix duu.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx dhɨt gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak xibhɨk bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jano' ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.

Ba' jix aa' gu Rebeeka gu Isaak; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ñ gu oidha' kuiñcha ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu et; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jakob jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu et na ja'p ma'nkam u'uuvɨ dhi' gu oidha' na ba' gu ñi'ook pai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaak jup tɨɨt gu Jakob jix bhai' aa' bham; gio ba' cham jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' bamii' tu' gu Padan-aram gu vaak gu Betuel gu taat gu naan jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Labaan xibhɨk gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix mui' jum duu tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu kai' bɨndak na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu Abraam.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Isaak gu Jakob ka't gu Padan-aram gu Labaan gu mar gu Betuel gu Arameo xibhɨk gu Rebeeka gu naan gu Jakob gu Esauu.

Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Esauu gu ñi'ook gu Isaak ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob ka't gu Padan-aram na ba' jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu u'vɨ; na pai' dhuuk jix bhai' aa' ka't jix duñia' bham; mi' dhɨr cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu Jakob ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat gu naan ka't gu Padan-aram.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esauu ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Kanaan cham bhai' gu Isaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Esauu gu Ismael jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu Maalet mar u'vɨ gu Ismael gu mar gu Abraam gu ja'tkam gu Nabaiot gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Jakob gu Beer-seba ka't jix duu.
Na gu' jix duñia' bɨɨx pai' jix koox na gu' tu' gu tas ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu jodai mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas jix duñia' mii' dhɨr pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu oidha' mo'o gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' daada' gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ jix dhaav.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'x; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu taat gu Jawatan Dios gu Isaak; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' jix duñia' tu' gu kai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu kai' na ja'p oo' gu oidha' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas gei'ñ tas buusñi saagi'ñ; gio ba' bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu oidha' ka't tu' gu kai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' bɨndak tu' pai' tu' dhi' gu oidha'; na gu' cham tu' bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' pai' tu' cham bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' pai' cham gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Jakob gu xibh jix bhɨɨ gu jodai ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'bon ja'aa bɨ'ñdhatu' tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Bet-el xoi'kam gu tasi' ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' na ba' jugi tɨi'chu' na ba' kutun.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu taat gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu jodai gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'bon ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx mambhɨɨx na ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Siguioo gu Jakob gu bhóogɨt ka't gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ñi' gu ñi'ook yooxi'; gio ba' vaik kakneer mia'n; na gu' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' ka't gu jodai bhaan gu chin gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx kakneer; gio ba' gu jodai bhaan gu chin gu ñi'ook kakneer; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu jodai bhaan gu chin gu ñi'ook pai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duukat tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu'ch.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu'p gu Labaan gu mar gu Nakôr gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' juraa'n bhai'x i'ii'ñ gui'p; mi' dhɨr bhai'x i'ii'ñ; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rakêl mar u'vɨ jupaabkamu'n bɨɨx gu vaakax.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook jix duu gu vaakax; jano' ba' kakneer tu'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm bɨx gu jodai bhaan gu chin gu ñi'ook na ba' kakneer.
Na gu' kua' gu ñi'ook a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx gu Rakêl suudai' u'va bɨɨx gu vaakax gu taat na gu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu Jakob jix ñi' gu Rakêl mar u'vɨ gu Labaan xibhɨk gu naan kakneer gu Labaan xibhɨk gu naan gu Jakob gu jodai bhaan gu chin gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu Labaan xibhɨk gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rakêl gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu Rakêl na ja'p ka't xibhɨk gu taat na ja'p ka't gu mar gu Rebeeka; gio ba' dai'bus jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Labaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob gu mar gu ja'tkam dai'bus tu jiim jix duñia' gu vaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Labaan bɨx dhi' tu'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu Labaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook o'o gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr juruuñ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Labaan gu Jakob; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' xibhɨk tu juan gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Labaan ga'ra' gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' jix gɨ' ka't gu Leea gu tɨɨgɨ' jix ali' gu Rakêl.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu Leea jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu' gu Rakêl ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rakêl; gio ba' tu' kɨɨv gu Rakêl mar u'vɨ jix ali'.
Jano' ba' gu Labaan jix aa'; gio ba' tutkɨ tu' jix maa tu' cham jix maa gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob gu Rakêl kɨɨv; na gu' na ja'p gu tanoolh na gu' dha'da'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu Labaan; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Labaan jum daa'ñ bɨx gu chio'ñ mii' dhɨr pai' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukaa' jix bhɨɨ gu Leea mar u'vɨ; gio ba' chɨbiapui.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Labaan ja'tkam na tu juan gu Silpa mar u'vɨ gu Leea gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios.
Jano' ba' namkia' gu xibh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Leea; gio ba' jix aa' gu Labaan; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook cham tu' jix duñia' gu Rakêl gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Labaan jix aa'; gio ba' cham duñia' chulhiiñdha' pai' jix maa jix ali' va'k jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kia'pɨx tu' maa'n gio kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kia'pɨx; gio ba' jix maa gu Rakêl mar u'vɨ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Labaan gu Rakêl mar u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios ja'tkam na tu juan gu Bila.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gio gu Rakêl; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu Leea; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios gu Leea ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kupi'ook; gu' gu Rakêl ka't gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Leea gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Rubeen na gu'; na gu' tu' tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu mar; na gu' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't tu' jix maa gio; mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Simeoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu mar; na gu' jano' dhi' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ na gu' vaik gu ma'nkam; na ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Lebii.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu mar; gio ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr dhi' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Judaa; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Rakêl cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Jakob jix duñia' jɨɨgak gu ja'tkam chɨtda gu Jakob; gio ba' gu ma'nkam tu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Rakêl chɨtda; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu i'bhɨ vook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu Bila; mi' dhɨr ba'k jix mar bhaan kɨkbok tu' gio gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Bila ja'tkam na tu juan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu Jakob chɨbiapui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bila gu Jakob gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rakêl; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gio jix kai gu ñi'ook jix maa gu mar; na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Bila ja'tkam na tu juan gu Rakêl gu mar gook gu Jakob.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rakêl; gio ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Neptalii.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Leea ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu Silpa ja'tkam na tu juan jix maa gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Silpa ja'tkam na tu juan gu Leea gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Leea; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Gad.
Jano' ba' gu Silpa ja'tkam na tu juan gu Leea gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Jakob.
Ba' jix aa' gu Leea; na ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu u'vɨ tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Aser.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Rubeen gu ñi'ook oraa' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Leea gu naan; gio ba' jix aa' gu Rakêl gu Leea; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu mar.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gio tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar jix aa' gu Rakêl; na gu' bɨndak dhi' gu tukaa' gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu xumai jix buus gu Leea; na gu' tu' baakɨi na gu' tu'r tu' gu mar; mi' dhɨr jix koox bɨɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu Leea; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob jixchamaam gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Leea; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook na gu' tu' ja'tkam na tu juan gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Issakâr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Leea jix duñia' xijumai gu mar gu Jakob.
Ba' jix aa' gu Leea; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jix bhai' jix duñia'; na gu' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na gu' gu ma'nkam; jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Sabuloon.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dina.
Jano' ba' tɨ'ñcho gu Jawatan Dios gu Rakêl jix kai gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Josee bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Rakêl ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josee gu Jakob gu Labaan; gio ba' tu' tu jiim pai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam jix duñia' bɨndak tu'; na gu' tu' ñɨidhat tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Labaan jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jano' nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook kuiñcha.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' ñɨidhat gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' dhi' gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k namkia' tu' jɨɨ'ñdhidha'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jano' duuk no'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' gio gu vaak.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa' gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'; jano' ba' tu' dhi' kakneer.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx kakneer dɨlhkob bɨx jix uam bɨx jix uam jix bhai'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ kakneer jix uam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx bhai' gu xibh na pai' dhuuk daraibu' vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' bɨx cham ua'tulhi'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook jix uam jix bhai'x kakneer tu' mambhɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Labaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jum duu na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiiw; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook jix uam bɨx ga'ra' gu ñi'ook jix toja bɨx jix uam jix bhai'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ kakneer jix dhaas gu noobh gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas vaik gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jakob; gio ba' gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer gu Labaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tanoolh na jix bhai' chooto jix toja.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't vupui bhaan gu vaakax gu suudai' pai' aajidha' i'i kakneer bai'ñpu' i'i.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jakob kaneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx kakneer jix bhai'x bɨx ka't jix bhai'x gu Labaan; gio ba' dɨlhkob cham bɨɨx kakneer gu Labaan.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'kim gu Jakob vupui bhaan kakneer na ba' ñiata.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk aajidha' kakneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba' jix duñia' na ba' gu Labaan na ba' gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix jai' jix duñia' mumua'da' kakneer tu duukam jix ai gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Oiia gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Labaan am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu Jakob tu' jix duñia' bɨx ka't chulhiiñdha' gu taat; mi' dhɨr ka't chulhiiñdha' gu taat tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu Jakob gu Labaan cham ka't na ba' bɨɨx na ja'p gu ñi'ook va'k gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' tattat; na tu' jix duñia' bɨndak.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jakob jup tɨɨt gu Rakêl gu Leea yooxi' kakneer.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat cham na ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook va'k gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu taat tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx mui'kim; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' tu' chɨtda; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' bɨx kakneer gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tu' chɨtda; gio ba' jix bhai'x ka't; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' bɨx kakneer gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu vaakax gu taat tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kakneer tu' gu vupui tu' tɨɨtki' gu u'vɨ jix duñia' jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨtki'; gio ba' gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu vupui bɨx gu ñi'ook kakneer jix bhai'x; na gu' tu' buupui bɨx gu Labaan tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Bet-el pai' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'bon pai'; gio ba' bamii' jano' jix buus dhi' gu oidha' na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Rakêl gu Leea gui'p; gio ba' tañia' tu' baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu taat.
Jano' ba' cham juraa'n tu' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx chulhiiñdha' u'uuk.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n chulhiiñdha' gu taat taata'n gu ma'nkam; gio ba' jano' gu vupui bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Jakob jix tɨ'ɨ gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ bhaan jix ai.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu vaakax bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu vaakax jix duñia' ka't gu Padan-aram na ba' jix joi'ñ gu Isaak gu taat gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu Labaan ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan kakneer; gio ba' gu Rakêl jix duñia' duiñxim gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob gu i'ii'ñ gu Labaan gu Arameo cham jix duñia' maachim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx ga'ra'; gio ba' jix búup gu ñi'ook gɨ' suudai' jiim jix dhaas gu vupui gu kavɨk gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Labaan vaik gu tanoolh na ja'p gu Jakob ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ja'tkam baidhak ka't bhaan gu bhóogɨt kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu Galaad.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu Labaan gu Arameo tɨɨtki' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu ñi'ook gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Labaan gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't vaak zel gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu Labaan jix dhaas bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu kavɨk gu Galaad.
Ba' jix aa' gu Labaan gu Jakob; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ja'p bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' na ba' cham chɨɨdak na ba' tu' bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook bɨɨx xoi'kam bɨɨx.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' jano' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch gu novɨ na ba' duñia' cham bhai'; gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat tu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bham; mi' dhɨr cham tu ñi'ook gu Jakob.
Na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu taat gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu Labaan; na gu' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ; na gu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' bakia' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tai; gio ba' vupui bhaan xibhɨk gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' palhɨɨp; mi' dhɨr gu Jakob cham bhai'x gu Rakêl ka't.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gu Labaan vaak zel gu Jakob vaak zel gu Leea vaak zel gook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios cham gu ñi'ook jix buus vaak zel gu Leea suudai' u'va vaak zel gu Rakêl.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Rakêl duiñxim jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ai jix daa bhaan; gio ba' vaak zel gu Labaan bɨx vaak zel cham gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu taat; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan na gu' cham jix búup vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' dhi' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ; jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu' cham gu ñi'ook duiñxim.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jakob bhaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Labaan; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu Labaan; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ bɨɨx tɨbiap.
Na gu' oilhimɨk bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gaagam bɨx gu vaak gu Ponlo vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bɨndak; gio ba' kakneer gu ñi'ook cham pai' dhuuk tu' gu ñi'ook kakneer.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu tanoolh na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ja'p gu tukaa' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tónom gu tukaa' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx mui'kim.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam choo'n gu Isaak cham mai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨda' jano' cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim gu noobh tu' jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu Labaan gu Jakob; gio ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam kakneer bɨx tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook dhi' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ma'nkam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu'; gio ba' ka't chuut tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jakob jix bhɨɨ gu jodai jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'bon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu jodai tu' jix duu; jano' ba' koi'mɨk bhaan mii' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Labaan gu Jegar gu Saaduta; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu Jakob gu Galaad.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Labaan; gio ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ookdham gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Galaad.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mispa na gu'; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na pai' dhuuk maa'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ tu' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ soo'mchulhdhak bɨɨx no'ch; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ookdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Labaan gu Jakob; gio ba' dhi' mo'bon gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
