Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Isaak gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix koi ka't gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Esauu gu Jakob gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Esauu gu Edom.
Jano' ba' gu Esauu jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Kanaan; gio ba' gu Ada mar u'vɨ gu Eloon gu eteo gu Aolibama mar u'vɨ gu Ana mar u'vɨ gu Sibeoon gu ebeo.
Jano' ba' gu Basemat mar u'vɨ gu Ismael gu ja'tkam gu Nabaiot.
Jano' ba' gu Ada gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esauu gu Elipas; gio ba' gu Basemat gu Reuel.
Jano' ba' gu Aolibama gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeuus gu Jaalam gu Kora; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Esauu gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu Esauu jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak bɨx gu vaakax bɨx ka't gu oidha' gu Kanaan ka't gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu Jakob xibhɨk.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix gɨ' cham gu ñi'ook jix daa tɨtda:―Aañ tu' gu oidha' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' gu Esauu jix daa gu kavɨk gu Seir; gio ba' gu Esauu gu Edom.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esauu gu taat gu Edom gu kavɨk gu Seir.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Esauu; gio ba' gu Elipas gu mar gu Ada gu u'vɨ gu Esauu; mi' dhɨr gu Reuel gu mar gu Basemat gu u'vɨ gu Esauu.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elipas jix bɨɨx duu gu Temaan gu Omar gu Sepo gu Gatam gu Kenas.
Jano' ba' gu Timna ka't gu u'vɨ gu Elipas gu mar gu Esauu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amalek; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Ada gu u'vɨ gu Esauu.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Reuel jix bɨɨx duu gu Naat gu Sera gu Samma gu Missa; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Basemat gu u'vɨ gu Esauu.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Aolibama gu u'vɨ gu Esauu mar u'vɨ gu Ana ka't mar u'vɨ gu Sibeoon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esauu gu Jeuus gu Jaalam gu Kora.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Esauu; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elipas maa'nkam mar gu Esauu; mi' dhɨr gu Temaan gu Omar gu Sepo gu Kenas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kora gu Gatam gu Amalek; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu Elipas gu oidha' gu Edom; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Ada.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Reuel gu mar gu Esauu; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Naat gu Sera gu Samma gu Missa; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam gu Reuel gu oidha' gu Edom; jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam jupaabkamu'n gu Basemat gu u'vɨ gu Esauu.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Aolibama gu u'vɨ gu Esauu; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeuus gu Jaalam gu Kora; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu moor gu Aolibama gu u'vɨ gu Esauu mar u'vɨ gu Ana.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Esauu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Edom.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Seir gu oreo gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Lotaan gu Sobal gu Sibeoon gu Ana.
Jano' ba' gu Disoon gu Eser gu Disaan; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oreos gu ma'nkam gu Seir gu oidha' gu Edom.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lotaan jix bɨɨx duu gu ori gu emaan; gio ba' gu Timna ka't gu ja'tkam gu Lotaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sobal jix bɨɨx duu gu Albaan gu Manaat gu Ebal gu Sepo gu Onaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sibeoon jix bɨɨx duu gu Aja gu Ana; na pai' dhuuk dhi' gu Ana jix ñi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu Sibeoon gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ana jix bɨɨx duu gu Disoon gu Aolibama mar u'vɨ gu Ana.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Disoon; gio ba' gu emdaan gu Esbaan gu Itram gu Keraan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Eser; gio ba' gu Bilaan gu Saabaan gu Akaan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Disaan; gio ba' gu us gu Araan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oreos; gio ba' gu Lotaan gu Sobal gu Sibeoon gu Ana.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Disoon gu Eser gu Disaan; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu oreos; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' gu Seir.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Edom va'k gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu dhi' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Bela gu mar gu Beor jix gɨ'kora' gu Edom; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham ka't gu Dinaba.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Bela jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Jobab gu mar gu Sera gu Bosra.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Jobab pai' jix gɨ'kora' gu usam gu oidha' gu Temaan.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu usam jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Adad gu mar gu Badad naaka'n gu Midiaan yooxi' gu Moab; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham ka't gu Abit.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Adad pai' jix gɨ'kora' gu Samla gu Masreka.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Samla jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Sauul gu Reobot gu Riio.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Sauul pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ'kora' gu Baalanaan gu mar gu Akbor.

Jano' ba' jix koi gu Baalanaan gu mar gu Akbor jix gɨ'kora' gu Adar pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham ka't gu Pau; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Meetabel mar u'vɨ gu Matred mar u'vɨ gu Mesaab.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esauu pai' gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu Timna gu Alba gu Jetet.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aolibama gu Ela gu Pinoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kenas gu Temaan gu Mibsar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Magdiel gu iram; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu Edom gu oidha' gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr gu Edom gu Esauu gu taat gu Idumeos.
Jano' ba' gu abitoo gu Jakob gu oidha' pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat gu oidha' gu Kanaan.

Jano' ba' dhi' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Jakob; gio ba' gu Josee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx kɨɨv kakneer bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr ka't bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Bila bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Silpa gu u'vɨ gu taat; jano' ba' gu Josee gu taat gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' dha'da' gu Israeel gu Josee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ma'nkam na gu' ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook jix uam.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu taat dha'da' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam cham gu ñi'ook ñiokda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josee gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' gu novɨ jix búup ka't gu ñi'ook gu novɨ mi'p xikoolh.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' bhaan no'ch tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan no'ch gu ñi'ook kuiñcha tɨɨtki' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gu tas gu masad gu si'avag tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' gu emos gu ñi'ook tu' gu naan gu ja'tkam tu' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam ko'kmarak jɨɨgak gu' gu taat gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer gu taat gu Sikêm.
Ba' jix aa' gu Israeel gu Josee; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer gu Sikêm; mi' dhɨr tu'; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook kakneer; mi' dhɨr bhañ gu ñi'ook gu ebroon gu Sikêm.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook yooxi' tɨtda:―¿Jax mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' duukat.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr tu' a'ga; jano' ba' gu Dotaan; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Josee ka't bhaan gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Dotaan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k mia'n bhaan na ba' mu'aa'.
Jano' ba' gui'p maa'n; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't tɨɨtki'.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Rubeen jix kai dhi' jix duñia' gu noobh; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rubeen; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr; mi' dhɨr dhi' oidha' jix gaki cham gu novɨ; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu noobh na ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu taat.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu Josee gu ja'tkam jix duu gu Josee gu ñi'ook jix uam ga'ra' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' ka't cham ka't gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix dhadhaa jugi gu takarui'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui chu'p gu Ismaelitas gu Galaad jix ai gu ux na tu ibai' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu Ejipto.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk koi'm.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ismaelitas cham ka't gu novɨ bhaan; na chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Midianitas jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josee aichdhak jiix gu ñi'ook gu Ismaelitas gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai; gio ba' bhɨɨk gu Josee gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu Rubeen gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook gu Josee gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' tu jiim tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu Josee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiiw gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ gu ñi'ook jix uam aichdhak gu taat gui'p; gio ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gaagam jano' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar; mi' dhɨr gu vaakax; jano' ba' gu Josee tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jakob jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu mar mui'x gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix búup bɨx gu ma'nkam bɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' gu ñi'ook; gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix aa'; na gu' tu' no'ñ jix dhaav gu mar bɨɨx ka'm; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu Midianitas gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto gu Potipar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Judaa jix dhaav bɨɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu chio'ñ gu Adullamita gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ira.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Judaa mar u'vɨ gu chio'ñ gu Kananeo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Suua; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ chɨbiapui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Er.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Onaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Sela; na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Kesib na pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ na ba' maa'nkam mar gu Er gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tamar.
Jano' ba' gu Er maa'nkam mar gu Judaa ka't cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Onaan; gio ba' ba'k gu u'vɨ xibhɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu kai' xibhɨk.
Na pai' dhuuk pu'ñir gu Onaan gu kai' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na jix bhai' na pai' dhuuk gu u'vɨ xibhɨk gu oidha' cham gu kai' xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gio gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Judaa gu Tamar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu vaak gu taat bɨɨx ka'm gu Sela gu mar; na gu' jix aa'; na cham gio na ja'p gu ja'tkam; gio ba' ka't gu Tamar juruuñ gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'x gu tanoolh jix koi mar u'vɨ gu Suua gu u'vɨ gu Judaa; gio ba' gu Judaa gu ñi'ook bhaan kakneer gu Timnat gu ira gu Adullamita.
Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Tamar bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' jix duñia' gu Timnat bhaan kakneer.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jajannulhi'ñ jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx jix duñia' jix dhaas ki'ñgob gu suudai' ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt gu Timnat; na gu' ka't gu Sela cham ka't gu u'vɨ.
Na gu' jix ñi' gu Judaa jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ganai' na gu' ka't jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' jix ai'chdhix gu bhóogɨt bhaan; gio ba' tu' jano' ba'k tu'; na gu' cham bhai'x ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' baakɨi tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax chiiw gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ; jano' ba' jix maa chɨbiapui.
Jano' ba' jix búup ka't; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa bhañ chiiw gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Adullamita na ba' jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu u'vɨ; gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Jax gu chichio'ñ mii' dhɨr pai' bham; gio ba' duukat ganai' gu suudai' ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt gui'p; mi' dhɨr cham tu' dhi' ganai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa; gio ba' cham gaagam; mi' dhɨr gio gu chichio'ñ pai' gui'p; jano' ba' cham tu' dhi' ganai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Judaa; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' na gu' cham tu'ch; mi' dhɨr tu' dhi' chiiw tu' cham bakia'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik masaa'n ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Judaa bham; gio ba' gu Tamar tu' jix duñia' tɨɨda' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Judaa jix aa'; jano' ba' jix buusñi ka't vaak na jix bhaan.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhañ a'ga gu ñi'ook na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ dhi' tu'x dhi' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' jano' dhi' tu'x.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' na gu' cham jix maa gu Sela gu mar; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gook vook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk jix buusñi gu novɨ maa'n baasɨ'n jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ bham; gio ba' dhi' jix buus maa'n.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ xibhɨk jix buus; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Pares.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix buus xibhɨk ga'ra' gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Sara.
Jano' ba' gu Llebado gu Josee gu Ejipto gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Potipar gu Faraoon gu chio'ñ gu Egipkio gu novɨ gu Ismaelitas baabuk.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx gu Josee ka't gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan gu Egipkio.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx bɨx jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Josee nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duu gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu vaak do'ñcho bɨx ga'ra'.

Ba' jix aa' ka't dɨr na pai' dhuuk jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak bɨx ga'ra' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' aa' gu vaak gu Egipkio kuiñcha gu Josee; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan bɨx ga'ra' gu vaak na ja'p yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx ga'ra' gu novɨ gu Josee; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx bhai'x cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Josee gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' gu u'vɨ gu Jawatan jix dhaas gu vupui gu Josee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu Jawatan cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu vaak tu' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ bɨx juraa'n.
Na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch jix gɨ' tu' dhi' gu vaak matgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook tu' na gu' tu' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' dhi' jix gɨ' cham bhai' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't a'gi'ñchu' gu Josee gu tanoolh cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ka't chɨbiapui gu tanoolh gu vaak na ba' duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't soo'mchulhdhak gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jakob gu taat gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ka't bham.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu'ch gu chichio'ñ tu'r cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam chulhiiñdha' gu taat; gio ba' maa'n cham gu ñi'ook jix ali' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx chulhiiñdha' gu taat gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan gu oidha'; gio ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ tu'r; mi' dhɨr tɨtda:―Cha'pim maa'n gu ja'tkam na ba' bhiogi' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xibhɨk jix ali' na ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ tu'r; gio ba' xibhɨk gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n ka't gu ñi'ook tuumiñ; gio ba' ñɨi'ñ gu taat gu ñi'ook tuumiñ chooto'n choo'n.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu taat gu Jakob; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr gu Josee cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu Simeoon gu Benjamiin; jano' ba' bhaan tu' bɨx dhi' tu'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rubeen gu taat bham; gio ba' jix duu koi gook gu ma'nkam tu' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ tu'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham jix dhaav gu mar bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; na xibhɨk jix koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia'; jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt pai' jix dhaav bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bhiogi' ka't jix gɨ' gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu jugi tiriik aichdhak gu Ejipto gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' no'ch jugi.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Judaa bham; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bham; mi' dhɨr cham chɨgia' gu vupui cham xibhɨk bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' tɨip chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk bɨɨx no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jugi.
Gu' gu' tu' cham tɨip cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham chɨgia' gu vupui cham xibhɨk bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ ga'ra' xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tɨtda:―¿Jax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch bham; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu taat namki' xibhɨk jurtu'nka' dhi' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' no'ch maachim ka't a'ga; gio ba' xibhɨk.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Israeel gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook cham vaak jodai no'ch tu' gu ñi'ook a'aalh.
Jano' ba' gu Yo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu' vupui bhaan tu' jix duñia' na ba' tu' bɨx gu tanoolh.
Na tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨda' jano' tu' gook mui'kim.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Israeel gu taat jix aa'; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr tutkɨ gu oidha' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu ux na tu ibai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh tuumiñ gu novɨ tuumiñ gu chin gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio xibhɨk jix búup mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Omnipotente jix maa i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam vupui bhaan mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xibhɨk dhi' gu Benjamiin; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ tuumiñ gu Benjamiin; gio ba' jix búup jix dhaav gu Ejipto vupui bhaan gu Josee.

Ba' jix aa' jix ñi' gu Josee gu Benjamiin bɨɨx gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu vaak; gio ba' jix duñia' gu vaak jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jugi tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu gu chio'ñ na ja'p gu Josee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu chichio'ñ gu vaak gu Josee.

Na pai' dhuuk mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ chooto'n choo'n na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Josee am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' tuumiñ ka't gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' na ba' bhaan no'ch bhaan no'ch gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu duukam no'ch gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu vaak gu Josee tu ñi'ook ba'k gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch tu'r gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p sɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tuumiñ maa'n ka't gu chin chulhiiñdha' tuumiñ jir bhai'; gio ba' jix toja jodai gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu novɨ gu noobh tuumiñ na ba'; gio ba' no'ch cham chɨkka ka't gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' tuumiñ gu novɨ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu taat jix maa chumñigam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; jano' ba' tuumiñ suudai' u'va tu'; gio ba' jix buusñi gu Simeoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu vaak gu Josee; gio ba' jix maa gu suudai' jix duñia' tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr jix maa jugi gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kapbhai' gu Josee tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh na gu' naak jugi gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Josee gu vaak aichdhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ko'kmarak gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu vaak tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Jax gu ñi'ook mi'p; gio ba' gu taat jix bhai'x tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' xoi'kam tu' tu duukam chulhiiñdha' gu taat; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; jano' ba' tu' jix duu tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui jix ñi' gu Benjamiin xibhɨk gu mar gu naan; gio ba' xibhɨk jix ali' tu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu mar.
Na gu' jano' ba' gu Josee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' ba'k kuiñcha xibhɨk pai' jix xuaak; gio ba' chɨbiapui gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu vupui jix buus mai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas na ba' dɨlhkob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' dɨlhkob na ba' gu Egipkios bɨɨx jugi; na gu' gu Egipkios cham jɨ'xdha' jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ebreos gu Egipkios.
Jano' ba' jix dhadhaa vupui bhaan jix gɨ' jurtu'nka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ali' jurtu'nka'; gio ba' mi'p mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ koi' vupui bhaan na ba'; gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Benjamiin ka't jixchamaam mui'kim na ja'p no'x; mi' dhɨr i'i bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Josee gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu vaak bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chio'ñ jix dhaas tuumiñ maa'n gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaaso jix toja jodai gu chin jix ali' bɨɨx tuumiñ tiriik; gio ba' jix duu na ja'p jix aa' gu Josee.
Jano' ba' namkia' gu xibh gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' dhaibu gu ñi'ook kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu Josee gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ; gio ba' bamii' jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' cham bhai' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'i gu Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan tu'x cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' xoi'kam tu duukam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuumiñ bakia' gu chin gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' dɨr gu oidha' gu Kanaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dua'ñ jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan jix toja jodai tu' jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr tu duukam ua'tulhi'ñ bakia' vaaso gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch duduaka' tu duukam gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gio jano' ka't jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bakia' ka't tu duukam boopoya' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu oidha' jix kupi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' dɨr jix gɨ' kua'da' jix bɨɨx duu jix ali'; mi' dhɨr vaaso ka't bakia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook maa'n gu ñi'ook suulh kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Josee ka't vupui bhaan gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na ja'p tu' jix duñia'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gaagam tu' na cham jir bhai' tu duukam; mi' dhɨr no'ch gu'ch tu duukam gu Jawatan no'ch gio ka't bakia' vaaso.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't bakia' vaaso ka't tu duukam; jano' ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan jix duñia' tu ñi'ook tu duukam gu ñi'ook maatɨt gu Jawatan cham bhaan tu duukam tu' na ja'p gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan tɨtda:―¿Jax tu duukam bham; gio ba' namki' gu taat xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; gio ba' tañia' gu taat jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ali'; mi' dhɨr xibhɨk jix koi gu ñi'ook gu naan gu taat xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook tu duukam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jɨ'xdha' gu ñi'ook gu taat na gu' tu' gu taat koi.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook tu duukam; gio ba' tu' xibhɨk jix ali' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham gu vupui.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' chulhiiñdha' gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi.

Jano' ba' no'ch tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk ua'tulhi'ñ bɨɨx no'ch; na gu' cham gu vupui gu chio'ñ cham kua' bɨɨx no'ch chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk jix ali'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tu duukam gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' maa'n jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tɨɨda' ka't bɨɨx ka'm jano' cham buupui.
Jano' ba' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' jix dhaav bɨɨx.
Na pai' dhuuk jano' na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu duukam gu taat cham ua'tulhi'ñ na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk cham koi; gio ba' tu duukam jix duu jix dhaav tu duukam chulhiiñdha' gu taat bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu duukam jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu taat bham; gio ba' tu' cham tu' jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' na ba' gu taat bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jano' tu duukam gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Jawatan bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook tu jiim tu' gu taat cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham cham bhai' daam gu taat.

Jano' ba' cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' tu' gu Josee jix duñia' vupui bhaan bɨx mi'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix buus bɨx; mi' dhɨr cham soo'mchulhdhak bɨɨx jix duu jix maati' gu Josee gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix maa jix xuaak gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios jix kai gio gu vaak gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Josee; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu ja'tkam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook na gu' mi'p vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josee gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu'; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Josee xibhɨk na ba' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jano' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x; na ba' gu oidha' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan.
Na tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook bhiogi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' jixchamaam tu' oraa'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' na ba' jix duu gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix gɨ' dodhia'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu Faraoon gu Jawatan bɨx gu vaak gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat ja'xñi; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu mar gu Josee; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan bɨx gu Ejipto; jano' ba' tu' cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Goseen dhi' mia'n tu' gu ma'nkam gu vaakax bɨx.
Na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam bhiogi' na gu' cham gampai' tu' gu vaak bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui xibhɨk gu Benjamiin gu chin tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim gu taat bɨx gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Ejipto bɨx jix duñia' buupui; gio ba' jix duñia' gu taat jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan baakux gu Benjamiin xibhɨk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio gu Benjamiin gu ñi'ook bhaan baakux.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bhaan; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Faraoon bham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Josee jix duñia' tɨbiap; mi' dhɨr gu vupui gu Faraoon tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon gu Josee; gio ba' tu' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax tu' gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Ejipto jugi gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi'; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' a'aalh gu u'vɨ; jano' ba' gu taat gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' cham jix maa cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Ejipto ka't.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix maa gu Josee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' gu Faraoon na ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' maa'n bɨx jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jajannulhi'ñ gu Benjamiin jix maa vaik jix toja jodai jixchamaam jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu taat bhañ dhi'; gio ba' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook tutkɨ gu Ejipto mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook tiriik gu takarui' jugi na ba' gu taat gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu Jakob gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' gu Josee jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto; jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Josee ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Josee gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jakob gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu Josee gu mar jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' tu jiim va'k tu'.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Israeel bɨɨx bɨx ga'ra' suudai' u'va gu Beer-seba makgɨrxi makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat gu Isaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat; na gu' cham jum i'obh jix dhaav gu Ejipto na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak gu Ejipto tu' gio tu'; gio ba' gu Josee gu novɨ bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Jakob gu Beer-seba; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu taat gu Jakob a'aalh gu u'vɨ gu Faraoon ka't na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu oidha' gu Kanaan tɨɨtɨs gu Ejipto gu Jakob bɨx gu kai' baidhak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam baidhak; gio ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ma'nkam bɨx gu kai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baidhak gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel baap gu Ejipto gu Jakob gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen; gio ba' gu anok gu Pallu gu esroon gu Karmi.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon; gio ba' gu Jemuel gu Jamiin gu Oad gu Jakîn gu Soar gu Sauul gu mar gu Kananea.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; gio ba' gu Er gu Onaan gu Sela gu Pares gu Sara; gu' gu Er gu Onaan jix koko' gu oidha' gu Kanaan; jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Pares jix bɨɨx duu gu esroon gu amul.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr; gio ba' gu Tola gu Pua gu Job gu Simroon.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sabuloon; gio ba' gu Sered gu Eloon gu Jaleel.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Leea gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob gu Padan-aram mar u'vɨ gu Dina; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vaik gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad; gio ba' gu Sipioon gu Aggi gu Esboon gu Suni gu eri gu Arodi gu Areli.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aser; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Isua tu' gu Isui gu Beria gu Sera gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Beria; jano' ba' gu eber gu Malkîel.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Silpa gu Labaan jix maa mar u'vɨ gu Leea gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ja'tkam gu Jakob; gio ba' mambhɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rakêl gu u'vɨ gu Jakob; gio ba' gu Josee gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josee gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Manasees gu Epraim gu Asenat mar u'vɨ gu Potipera jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jix bɨɨx duu gu Bela gu Bekêr gu Asbel gu Gera gu Naamaan gu Ei gu Ros gu Muppim gu uppim gu Ard.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Rakêl gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dan; gio ba' gu usim.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii; gio ba' gu Jaseel gu Guni gu Jeser gu Sillem.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Bila jix maa gu Labaan gu Rakêl mar u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ja'tkam gu Jakob; gio ba' bɨx kɨɨv gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx gu Jakob gu Ejipto cham gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam gu Jakob bɨx jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gook; gio ba' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu Jakob baap gu Ejipto jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Judaa vupui bhaan gu Josee na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Goseen; gio ba' gu oidha' gu Goseen.
Jano' ba' gu Josee tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va gu Israeel gu taat gu Goseen; gio ba' bhaan baakux gu ñi'ook bhaan baakux.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Israeel gu Josee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jano' tu' buupui gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim gu Faraoon; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu taat mi'p gu oidha' gu Kanaan jix duñia' tɨbiap tu'.
Na gu' gu chichio'ñ bipia'dam kakneer na gu' gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' kakneer bɨx ko'kmarak.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Faraoon mɨmɨim tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' tu duukam dɨr bɨɨx ka'm jano' no'ch gu ñi'ook tattat; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Goseen na gu' gu Egipkios bɨx bipia'dam kakneer.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josee suudai' u'va tu' jix duu maachim gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu taat gu ja'tkam kakneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx namki' jix duñia' tɨbiap gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu oidha' gu Goseen.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix bhɨɨ jixchamaam gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Faraoon; mi' dhɨr bipia'dam kakneer tu duukam no'ch na ja'p taata'n tattat.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu oidha' tɨbiap; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' kakneer tu duukam bhiogi' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu oidha' gu Kanaan; na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jano' tu duukam pai' gu Goseen.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Faraoon gu Josee bham; gio ba' gu taat gu ja'tkam jix duñia' tɨbiap tu'.

Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Ejipto vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' tutkɨ gu oidha' gu vupui jix daa gu taat gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' gu Goseen; jano' ba' tu' cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ jix dhaas gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu Josee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat vupui bhaan gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu Jakob jix bhai' aa' gu Faraoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon gu Jakob; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu Jakob jix aa' gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chamaam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tomaat jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu oidha' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu oidha' tattat gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jakob jix bhai' aa' gu Faraoon jix buus vupui bhaan gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josee jix daa gu taat gu ja'tkam jix maa gu maa'nkar gu oidha' gu Ejipto tutkɨ gu oidha' pai' gu Rameses na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josee gu taat gu ja'tkam bɨx gu vaak gu taat gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu chin gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gu takarui' bɨx gu oidha' bhiogi' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhiogi' gu oidha' gu Ejipto pai' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josee bɨx tuumiñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Kanaan; gio ba' gu Josee tuumiñ gu vaak gu Faraoon.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tuumiñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Kanaan suudai' u'va bɨx gu Ejipto gu Josee bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook koi vupui bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tuumiñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook tuumiñ.
Jano' ba' aichdhak gu vaakax gu Josee; gio ba' gu Josee jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo gu vaakax kakneer gu vaakax gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' bɨx gu vaakax mii' dhɨr kakneer.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr oi'ñga' tɨɨtɨs gook oi'ñga' gui'p; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan tuumiñ gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gio gu vaakax tu' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan; jano' ba' cham tu' tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook koi vupui bhaan gu vupui no'ch na ja'p gu oidha' gu Koompranos no'ch gu oidha' gu takarui' duduaka' no'ch pai' tu duukam gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu kai' na ba' cham vaak jodai cham ka't pai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josee bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' gu Faraoon; na gu' gu Egipkios gu ñi'ook maa'n oi'ñga'n na gu' bhiogi' bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' suudai' u'va gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan cham na gu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan ko'kmarak gu Faraoon gu ñi'ook gu Faraoon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na ba' gu Faraoon; mi' dhɨr gu kai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu i'bhɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam gu Faraoon maakobh ka't na ba' jugi gu vaak na ba' a'aalh.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu oidha' jix maa; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu Jawatan tu'ch tu duukam gu Faraoon.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josee jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' gu Ejipto nɨi'ñchudat na ba' gu Faraoon jixchamaam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan cham ka't gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Goseen; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mui'.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Jakob gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tanoolh gu Jakob pai' chamaam oo'm kɨɨv.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu Israeel na ba' koi jup tɨɨt gu Josee gu mar; gio ba' tu' gaagam jano' nɨidhidha' gu vupui jix duñia' gu novɨ bɨtaa'n jix duu xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' cham gu Ejipto.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tattat gu Ejipto tukga'n; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Israeel bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Sukedioo mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Josee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat ka'ook; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ baidhak gook gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' jix duu maachim gu Jakob bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Josee jupaabkamu'n tu'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Israeel jix daa bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Omnipotente jix ñi'ñ gu tasi' gu oidha' gu Kanaan jix bhai' aa'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu oidha' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jano' gook gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu Manasees tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto va'k tu' gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' na ja'p gu Rubeen gu Simeoon ka't.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ja'tkam ka't mɨmɨim dɨppɨr.

Na pai' dhuuk na gu' na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Padan-aram jix koi gu Rakêl gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu bhóogɨt na ja'p ɨraab gu oidha' bai'ñpu' gu Eprata; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Eprata gu Betleem.
Ba' jix aa' jix ñi' gu Israeel gu ma'nkam gu Josee; gio ba' chɨkka suulhgia'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu taat; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu' jix bhai' aa'.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu Israeel mi'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai'; gio ba' jix duu jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Israeel gu Josee; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gio gu kai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josee jix buusñi tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨkbok tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Josee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epraim kɨɨ'n gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Manasees o'nsop tu jiim gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duu.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨ'n jix dhaas bhaan mo'o gu Epraim ka't jix ali' bhaan mo'o gu Manasees gu noobh gu Manasees ka't maa'nkam mar.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa' gu Josee; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat gu Abraam tu' gu Isaak gu Jawatan Dios dɨr tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu Angel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx cham bhai' dhi' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' tattat gu Abraam tu' gu Isaak; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Josee gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tu jiim bhaan mo'o gu Epraim dhi'; gio ba' gu novɨ gu taat na ba' bhaan mo'o gu Epraim mo'o gu Manasees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu taat; na gu' cham gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' maa'nkam mar; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas kɨɨ'n bhaan mo'o.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu taat cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu mar tu'; mi' dhɨr gio ɨlhdham gu ja'tkam ka't gio; gu' xibhɨk jix ali' ka't jix gɨ' gu kai' ka't chɨbɨɨp.

Ba' jix aa' jix bhai' aa' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bham; gio ba' tu' jix bhai' aa' gu Israeel bham; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Epraim na ja'p gu Manasees; jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Epraim vupui bhaan gu Manasees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Israeel gu Josee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu oidha' tattat.
Jano' ba' tu' jix maa tu' baasɨ'n bhaan gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu novɨ gu Amorreo bɨɨx gu kuchii bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Jakob gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Jakob; gio ba' gu taat gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Rubeen tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkam mar gu kavɨk bɨɨpɨ'; gio ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu suudai' cham gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; na gu' dhim gu taat; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' tu' jix tɨ'ɨ dhaibu'.
Jano' ba' gu Simeoon gu Lebii gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ɨxchuixim cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ tu' nɨidhat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chu'p; na i'iich mu'aa gu chio'ñ aagak vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich ka't; gio ba' daak ka't; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jakob gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu taat tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maavɨt gu Judaa; gio ba' gu mar; mi' dhɨr na ja'p maavɨt na ja'p maavɨt jix bhai'x; jano' ba' chɨkka.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu Silo; gio ba' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhuru'x gu ñi'ook gu mar gu ñi'ook jix duñia' suudai' u'va tɨi'chu' gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va taatam jix toja bii'm.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' ka't na ba'; gio ba' gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu Sidoon.
Jano' ba' gu Issakâr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix bhai' gu oidha' ka't; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' namki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu Dan gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam na ja'p bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Dan gu ko'oi ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan kavaayo.
Jano' ba' tulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Gad ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Aser ka't jix duñia' maa'n gu oidha' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam na tu juan tɨtda:―Cha'pim maa'n tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josee ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi jix duñia' bhaan vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' u'u gat.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu noobh jix kavɨk gu Jakob bipia'dam gu jodai gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Omnipotente tu' jix bhai' aa' bɨɨx jix bhai' aa' gu tɨkɨr jiix bɨɨx jix bhai' aa' jix dhaam suudai' bɨɨx jix bhai' aa' baaso.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu ñi'ook ka't bhaan mo'o gu Josee bhaan gu Nasareo gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Benjamiin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu xibh jugi gu xumai.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu taat jix aa' jix bhai' aa'; mi' dhɨr maa'n jix bhai' aa'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx tattat jumpa'n yooxi' gu Eproon gu eteo.
Jano' ba' jumpa'n yooxi' gu Makpela vupui bhaan gu Mamre gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam bɨɨx yooxi' gu Eproon gu eteo na ba' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu Saara gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Isaak gu Rebeeka gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Leea.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook yooxi' jumpa'n ka't gu ma'nkam gu et.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam tɨɨt; gio ba' ka't bɨɨx tattat.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josee bhaan gu vupui gu taat gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Josee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu taat; gio ba' gu Israeel.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm gu tanoolh na gu' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu Egipkios gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu Josee gu vaak gu Faraoon bham; gio ba' tu' gaagam jano' nɨidhidha' gu vupui soi'ñ tu ñi'ook maatɨt gu Faraoon bham.
Jano' ba' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr tukga'n tu' na ba' tu' gu oidha' gu Kanaan; jano' ba' soi'ñ tu' jano' gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Faraoon; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu taat na ja'p tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josee jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu taat; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx bɨx tu duukam gu Faraoon daraa gu vaak bɨx daraa gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaak gu Josee gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Goseen a'aalh kakneer.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gio bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam kavaayo tu' gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu Atad baasɨ'n gu Jordaan bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Josee jix duu gu taat kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu Kananeos gu ñi'ook ka't gu Atad gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' dhi' gu Egipkios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Abelmisraim baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam bɨɨx bhaan ka't jix duñia'.

Na gu' bhɨɨk gu ma'nkam gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu ñi'ook jumpa'n yooxi' gu Makpela ka't gu ñi'ook gu Abraam bɨɨx yooxi' na ba' gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eproon gu eteo vupui bhaan gu Mamre.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josee gu Ejipto gu ja'tkam bɨx jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu taat mi' dhɨr ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Josee gu taat ka't jix koi gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Josee maa'n bɨx cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ a'ga gu Josee; gio ba' gu taat jix aa'ñdhix va'k koi'm bham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josee; na gu' jix duñia' jano' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ja'tkam uañi'ñ na gu' cham bhai' tu'; na ba' gu ñi'ook jano' tu' tu' na cham jir bhai' tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu taat; jano' ba' gu Josee gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gio gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gui'p; gio ba' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Josee; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' bhaan tu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na ba' duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu oidha' jix jai' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhi'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' juruuñ gu Josee gu Ejipto gu vaak gu taat; gio ba' jix oidha' gu Josee chamaam mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Josee gu ma'nkam gu Epraim bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gio gu ma'nkam gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees jix bɨɨx duu bhaan kɨkbok gu Josee.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix duñia' o'oo.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Josee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chamaam mambhɨɨx; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto.
